sim-esim-wifi-korea.text: If you would rather have it sorted before you land, you can compare Korea eSIMs, airport SIM pick-ups and pocket Wi-Fi rental in one place, and keep the QR code or voucher on your phone.
links: Compare eSIM, SIM and Wi-Fi on Klook
sim-esim-wifi-korea.title: Get your Korea eSIM before you fly

dmz-tour-guide.after: How to choose a DMZ tour
dmz-tour-guide.text: Most first-time visitors book a coach tour with pick-up in Seoul. Looking online a few days ahead lets you compare routes and see which dates are running; tours can be cancelled at short notice, so read the refund terms.
dmz-tour-guide.title: Book a DMZ tour from Seoul

seoul-travel-pass.text: If the sums work for your itinerary, you can buy the pass online before your trip. Check which version you are buying and how it is collected or activated.
seoul-travel-pass.title: Buy the Discover Seoul Pass online

incheon-airport-to-seoul.text: You can buy an AREX Express ticket online before you fly, which saves working out the ticket machines after a long flight. Follow the redemption steps on the voucher when you reach the station.
incheon-airport-to-seoul.title: Buy your AREX Express ticket ahead

nami-island-gapyeong.text: A day tour with transport from Seoul is the least effort, and most of them combine Nami Island with the Garden of Morning Calm, Petite France or the Gangchon rail bike.
links: See Nami Island tours on Klook
nami-island-gapyeong.title: Nami Island day tours from Seoul

korea-ski-resorts-guide.text: For a first ski day, booking the lift pass, gear rental and a beginner lesson together online is simpler than arranging each at the resort. Vivaldi Park is one of the easiest resorts to reach from Seoul.
korea-ski-resorts-guide.title: Ski pass, rental and lesson in one booking

lotte-world-vs-everland.text: Both parks sell tickets online for overseas visitors, often for less than the gate price. Bring your passport if the ticket is for foreigners only.
lotte-world-vs-everland.title: Theme park tickets online

ktx-train-guide.text: If the pass makes sense for your route, you can buy a KORAIL PASS online before you travel and then reserve your seats.
ktx-train-guide.title: KORAIL PASS for foreign visitors

busan-1-day-itinerary.after: Practical tips for a day in Busan
busan-1-day-itinerary.text: If you plan to pay for several attractions in one day, the Visit Busan Pass bundles many of them for a fixed price. Check that the places you want are on its list before you buy.
busan-1-day-itinerary.title: Visit Busan Pass

wowpass-card-korea.text: You can also order a WOWPASS card online before your trip. Check the pick-up point and what is included on the booking page.
wowpass-card-korea.title: Order a WOWPASS card ahead

hanbok-rental-guide.title: Reserve a hanbok rental ahead
hanbok-rental-guide.text: Walk-ins are fine on quiet days, but a reservation guarantees your slot at weekends and in blossom and autumn season. This is one bookable shop near the palace; check what is included, such as hairstyling and the rental hours.

jeju-3-day-itinerary.title: Car rental or a day tour on Jeju
jeju-3-day-itinerary.text: A rental car is the easiest way to follow this plan, and you need an International Driving Permit to pick one up. If you do not drive, a small-group day tour covers one side of the island at a time.

seoul-3-day-itinerary.title: N Seoul Tower observatory ticket
seoul-3-day-itinerary.text: The plaza around the tower is free, but the observatory needs a ticket. Buying it online before you go is often cheaper than the counter and saves a queue at sunset.
links: N Seoul Tower ticket on Klook

korea-7-day-itinerary.title: Is a KORAIL PASS worth it for this route?
korea-7-day-itinerary.text: This plan uses two or three KTX rides. Add up the single fares first; if a pass comes out cheaper for your dates, you can buy one online before you travel and then reserve your seats.

korea-10-day-itinerary.title: Is a KORAIL PASS worth it for this route?
korea-10-day-itinerary.text: With Seoul, Jeonju, Gyeongju and Busan on one trip, the train fares add up. Compare the single tickets with a pass for your dates; a pass is bought online before you travel, and you still reserve each seat.

day-trips-from-seoul.title: Day tours from Seoul
day-trips-from-seoul.text: Most of these trips are easy to do on your own by train or bus. A coach tour makes sense for places with awkward transfers, such as the DMZ, Nami Island with the Garden of Morning Calm, or a ski resort.
links: See day trips from Seoul on Klook

seoul-with-kids.title: Tickets for a rainy or cold day
seoul-with-kids.text: Indoor attractions are busiest at weekends and in school holidays. Tickets bought online ahead are often cheaper than at the gate, and some are for overseas visitors only, so carry passports.

seoraksan-hikes.title: Seoraksan as a day tour from Seoul
seoraksan-hikes.text: If you are based in Seoul and short on time, a coach tour saves the bus transfers. It leaves only a few hours in the park: enough for the cable car or a short valley walk, not for Ulsanbawi.

seoul-neighborhoods-guide.title: Compare hotels by neighbourhood
seoul-neighborhoods-guide.text: Once you have picked an area, check a few places within a five-minute walk of a subway station. Prices jump at weekends, in cherry blossom season and in October, so compare your exact dates before you commit.

korea-travel-budget.title: Check room prices for your dates
korea-travel-budget.text: Room rates decide most of your budget, and they change a lot with the season and the day of the week. Looking up your real dates is the quickest way to see which of the sample budgets below fits you.

korea-domestic-flights-budget-airlines.title: Compare fares across airlines
korea-domestic-flights-budget-airlines.text: Domestic fares differ a lot between airlines and times of day, so look at several carriers for your exact date before you buy. Check what the fare includes, especially checked baggage, before you pay.
links: Seoul to Jeju flights on Trip.com

kpop-seoul-guide.title: Try a K-pop dance class
kpop-seoul-guide.text: If you would rather join in than watch, one-day group dance classes in Seoul teach a current choreography in English and film you at the end. Classes are date-specific, so book a slot before you travel.

olive-young-korea-guide.after: What to buy on a first visit
olive-young-korea-guide.title: Find your colours before you shop
olive-young-korea-guide.text: A personal colour analysis tells you which shades of make-up and clothing suit your skin tone, which makes choosing among hundreds of tints much easier. Studios in Myeongdong take bookings in English; sessions fill up, so reserve ahead.
links: Personal colour analysis in Myeongdong on Creatrip

visit-busan-pass.text: If the sums work for your plans, you can buy the pass online before you fly and collect the card in Busan, or use the mobile version.
visit-busan-pass.title: Visit Busan Pass
